name: Vanessa Le Court
source: The mysterious Vanessa works at Lady Luck as a bartender. Unlike many other vampires, she is not bloodthirsty at all and leads a civilized life, eating only to survive. She has an obvious talent for making cocktails, and she's also into DJing.
